summary: Verified the new 'Move documents between courses' feature end-to-end on web (Expo web preview). All acceptance criteria from the review request pass. Desktop 1280x800: logged in via POST /api/auth/request-code + /api/auth/verify (test@copythat.app / 246810), injected token into localStorage['copythat.token'], created TEST_A & TEST_B via UI, created doc 'TEST_doc_move' in TEST_A. Clicking move-doc-<id> did NOT navigate to the doc (URL unchanged: /archive) — onPress is correctly scoped to the folder icon. move-modal opened; it listed TEST_B and Inkorg (the account's pre-existing default course) but did NOT list TEST_A (self-filter works). move-cancel closes the modal with no change. Clicking the backdrop (outside the card) also closes the modal with no change. Clicking move-to-<TEST_B id> issued PATCH /api/documents/{id} {course_id}: modal closed, doc disappeared from TEST_A list immediately, sidebar counts updated instantly to TEST_A=0 / TEST_B=1, doc visible in TEST_B, and still there after full page reload (GET /api/documents?course_id=B returns TEST_doc_move). Regression: rename-doc-<id> still opens the RenameModal. Mobile 390x844: same flow works — doc card shows both the move (folder-open-outline) and rename (create-outline) icons without overflow, title truncates, moved doc from TEST_B back to TEST_A (counts flipped A=1 / B=0). Cleaned up by DELETE /api/courses/{TEST_A id} and /api/courses/{TEST_B id} — both returned 200.

critical_code_review_comments: MoveModal.tsx:20 targets = courses.filter(c => c.id !== currentCourseId) — correctly excludes the current course. Verified the opened modal had 2 rows (Inkorg + TEST_B) when the doc was in TEST_A, and did not include TEST_A.
MoveModal.tsx:35 Modal transparent + animationType='fade' with a Pressable absoluteFill backdrop before the card — outside-tap-to-close works on web.
archive.tsx:40-45 moveDoc: optimistic setDocs(filter id) then loadCourses() for count refresh — observable as immediate list disappearance and up-to-date sidebar counts without a visible flicker.

archive.tsx:350 move-doc button has hitSlop={8} and 36x36 inner size which combined gives >44pt effective tap target. Icon lives inside its own Pressable with onPress={onMove}; outer docCard Pressable's onPress still navigates to /doc/id when the card is tapped elsewhere — no event propagation issue observed (URL stayed on /archive when tapping the move icon).

'Det finns ingen annan kurs' branch (MoveModal.tsx:42) was not exercised because the test account always has the system Inkorg course. The code path is a trivial length check so this is low risk; recommend the main agent add a UI unit test or allow a seed-time flag to simulate the single-course state if deeper coverage is desired.

success_rate.backend: n/a (frontend-only request; backend PATCH /documents/{id} with {course_id} responded 200 for every call)
success_rate.frontend: 100% — all 8 acceptance checks (no-nav, self-filter, cancel, outside-click, move, immediate removal, sidebar counts, reload persistence) + regression (rename) + mobile viewport passed

seed_data_creation: Created 2 courses (TEST_A, TEST_B) and 1 document (TEST_doc_move). All cleaned up at end of test via DELETE /api/courses/{id} (cascades to the doc).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login pattern that works for the Expo web preview: POST {EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL}/api/auth/request-code {email}, then /api/auth/verify {email,code=246810}, body.token is a string; set localStorage['copythat.token'] = JSON.stringify(token) BEFORE reload. The test account always has a system 'Inkorg' course in addition to any TEST_ courses — so the 'no other course' / single-course branch of MoveModal cannot be exercised through this user without extra backend seeding. move-doc-<id> and rename-doc-<id> live inside the docCard Pressable; onPress on the inner Pressables does not propagate on web (verified), so clicking them does not open the document.
